speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are at my table in the middle of the day. I am not asking why. I am asking whether the page ate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He got off the wall. He is at the foot of it. I have not given him a speech for the ground.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Off a wall. Did he fall, or did he come down?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He came down. There is a difference, and I have not written it cleanly.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Down is a slow thing if a man is proud. Cloth also, when it is lowered and not dropped. I do not know your king.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I know dinner. Threepence. And the cat is on the book that is not yours. Gib may stay. I am not lifting him into a bite.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. The chronicle is Master Field's, and Master Field's book is still in the house. I am not sending it back today.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib does not count. He sits. I will not lift him if he means to bite.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat, and let the cat be a weight on another man's leaves. Your king can wait on a full spoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He can wait. The ground is tomorrow's if the afternoon fails me. Today he is only down.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: If you are saving the hard part, that is a weaver's order too. The shuttle also waits, and the cloth is still cloth.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is there a fool in it? Master Kemp likes a fool. I hear him through floors that are not ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no fool in this one. I have not told him so. I am not telling him at supper.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Kemp is a noise I do not buy. Your dinner is threepence whether the king eats or not.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will eat. The chronicle can spare the cat for an hour, or not. I have no quarrel with a cat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him where he is. A shut book would be kinder, and I have not shut it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the leaves stay, and the cat stays, and you stay until the bowl is honest. I will not have a man faint on a Wednesday and call it a trade.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The bread is the bread. I was not told to measure it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A finger and a half short of the notch, and a penny, and you will not measure it either. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny, a finger and a half, and a king on the ground with no speech. I have the afternoon for the speech, if the afternoon is kind.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Kindness is a full bowl. I can understand a thing that waits.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the bowls when they are empty. Gib can keep the book. I am not a critic.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are the maid, which is more useful. Threepence on the dresser. Mark me.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A full bowl, and the wall after. I will not improve the king.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence, Mistress. The page is where I left it. I am going back up when the bowl is done, and not before.
